decision_conditions: <p>The signage, by virtue of the combination of the poor design and siting results in a prominent, cluttered and obtrusive frontage to the building which is harmful to and out of character with the visual amenity of the area and character and appearance of the Listed Building and of the Conservation Area. The proposal would thereby be contrary to the provisions of Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, The Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 2007, Policy HC 1 C of The London Plan (2021) Policy CS1 of Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1 and DM 7 of Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and Harrow on the Hill Village Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy</p>

<p>The replacement windows, by virtue their poor design and siting result in a prominent addition that creates a distinctly modern character that is harmful and out of keeping with the visual amenity of the area and character and appearance of the Listed Building and of the Conservation Area. The proposal would thereby be contrary to the provisions of Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, The Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990,&nbsp; Policy HC 1 C of The London Plan (2021) Policy CS1 of Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1 and DM 7 of Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and Harrow on the Hill Village Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy.</p>
